description: Asks OSV.dev which advisories affect each component (purl@version), and each distro package (deb, rpm, apk) by the OSV source package its SBOM states (Debian:12 glibc, Alpine:v3.19 openssl, ...), and returns every response as canonical JSON, one Capture each. OSV does the version matching; a distro package with no source package is never asked.
name: security.osv.query
